node.statement: Conditional diagonal inverse clause. If Ha^Q_{P,P} has level-one lower modulus at least 1/4 and is bijective at level one, then lem-hcb3-diagonal-inverse and e<=e_H<=e_inv imply that every amplification is bijective and ||((Ha^Q_{P,P})_n)^(-1)||<=1+C_inv*e<=1+C_H*e for every n>=1.
node.inference: finite constant aggregation and direct application of validated registry imports
